mapper.select: SELECT gm.goods_id AS goodsId, gm.name AS commodityName, gm.description AS description, ( SELECT COALESCE(m.media_url, mr.url) FROM goods_room_category_rel rel JOIN room_category_media m ON m.room_category_id = rel.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 LEFT JOIN media_resource mr ON mr.media_resource_id = m.media_resource_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rel.goods_id = gm.goods_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS mainPhoto, gm.selling_price_cent AS sellingPriceCent, gm.original_price_cent AS originalPriceCent, gm.settlement_price_cent AS settlementPriceCent, ( SELECT gs.sku_name FROM goods_sku gs WHERE gs.goods_id = gm.goods_id AND gs.is_deleted = 0 AND gs.status = 'published' ORDER BY gs.sort_no ASC, gs.goods_sku_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS purchaseTermLabel FROM goods_main gm WHERE gm.camp_id = #{catalogCampId} AND gm.goods_id = #{goodsId} AND gm.is_deleted = 0 AND gm.status = 'published' LIMIT 1
SELECT rel.room_category_id FROM goods_room_category_rel rel WHERE rel.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY rel.id ASC
